name: Rakuen Yuki
source: Taisei spends his days working at a convenience store. Nothing ever changes--until the day a briefcase full of cash was dropped in front of him. Suddenly there are scary guys after him and the briefcase. Now, with the help of his friends, he is on the run to stay alive....
translation: 大成每天都在便利店工作，生活始终一成不变——直到某天，一个装满现金的公文包掉在他面前。突然间，一群凶恶男子开始追赶他，试图夺走公文包。如今，他只能在朋友帮助下不断逃亡，设法保住性命…
